BackstoryDef.title: vault test subject
BackstoryDef.description: Exposed to experimental mutagens inside an isolated underground vault, [PAWN_nameDef] endured painful physical transformation without losing [PAWN_possessive] sanity. Locked in a solitary cell by terrified peers, [PAWN_pronoun] spent years reading salvaged terminals to preserve [PAWN_possessive] humanity.

BackstoryDef.title: calm mutant leader
BackstoryDef.description: After escaping both vault confinement and brutal Enclave captivity, [PAWN_nameDef] dedicated [PAWN_possessive] immense strength to protecting peaceful travelers. Thoughtful and eloquent despite [PAWN_possessive] hulking frame, [PAWN_pronoun] guides fellow rational mutants toward coexistence with the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: gentle outcast
BackstoryDef.description: Unlike [PAWN_possessive] aggressive kin who lived only for raiding and bloodshed, [PAWN_nameDef] never felt the urge to crush smaller creatures. Driven out of the warband for refusing to fight, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to forage and survive alone in the ruins.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering mutant trader
BackstoryDef.description: Roaming the dangerous highways of the wasteland with a pack full of salvaged trinkets, [PAWN_nameDef] greets every stranger with warm curiosity and a good story. Though humans often panic at [PAWN_possessive] size, [PAWN_possessive] genuine kindness quickly wins them over.

BackstoryDef.title: tower brawler
BackstoryDef.description: Born into a violent mutant tribe occupying a ruined skyscraper, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years smashing scrap metal and wrestling rivals. [PAWN_pronoun] respected only brute strength and straightforward honesty, despising sneaky tactics and weak excuses.

BackstoryDef.title: seeker of human kindness
BackstoryDef.description: Fascinated by an old theater performance [PAWN_pronoun] witnessed while captive, [PAWN_nameDef] set out across the wasteland in search of the secret behind human power. Blunt, loyal, and terrifying in close combat, [PAWN_pronoun] eagerly crushes enemies while looking for literal human kindness.

BackstoryDef.title: pre-war researcher
BackstoryDef.description: Before the world burned and mutagens reshaped [PAWN_possessive] body, [PAWN_nameDef] was a quiet, methodical student of biology and electronics. [PAWN_pronoun] preferred working alone in dimly lit laboratories over crowded lecture halls.

BackstoryDef.title: reclusive mutant scholar
BackstoryDef.description: Retaining [PAWN_possessive] sharp mind after mutation, [PAWN_nameDef] retreated from aggressive mutant warbands to live in foggy isolation. Surrounded by salvaged terminals and tamed wasteland hounds, [PAWN_pronoun] quietly studies biology and trades rare supplies with trusted visitors.

BackstoryDef.title: institute prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in the sterile underground halls of a secretive scientific enclave, [PAWN_nameDef] showed an early gift for genetics and molecular biology. [PAWN_pronoun] believed purely in progress through science, sheltered from the harsh realities of the surface world.

BackstoryDef.title: mutated fugitive scientist
BackstoryDef.description: Horrified by the unethical human experiments [PAWN_pronoun] was ordered to oversee, [PAWN_nameDef] sabotaged the lab and injected [PAWN_objective]self with a custom mutagen strain to survive the irradiated wasteland. Brilliant yet deeply paranoid, [PAWN_pronoun] hides in remote caves working tirelessly on a cure.
